`Select.popup.test.ts` tests the place: the inline transforms after the measure, a padding of the popup, a right-to-left select with no value, `--anchor-width` of a custom anchor, a page `zoom`, `max-height: 0`, a pinch zoom, a scroll of the popup beside Select.List, the hover of the items at the edges and the keys that grow the popup. `Select.test.ts` tests the attributes, the first focus, `finalFocus` and the alignment, and `alignment.test.ts` the geometry with the numbers of these cases.
